about: The service areas of BinBin's app map, its public geofences of type 2, one for each system of data/turkish-scooter-feeds.json that names it by its binbinAppArea. The cache sweeps each outline until every point inside it is within a reply that lists every scooter that near, and keeps the scooters inside it (server/binbinApp.ts).
areaSource: BinBin's geofences (POST https://gatewayapi-sp.binbinapp.com/binbin/api/v1/geofences/get-by-type), simplified to within 5 m by scripts/update-binbin-areas.mjs
